title: Phase 2：證明 OEIS A085588（規則 150 環的最終週期）整除 2^D(2^s−1)，並指出條目原句方向寫反

A085588-dvd.proof: Lean (core only) for every n = 2^D m with m | 2^s -+ 1: F^(2^D + 2^D(2^s-1)) = F^(2^D) on every ring state (GF(2) Frobenius: 2^j steps = spread by 2^j; 2^(D+s) = +-2^D mod n), hence the eventual period divides 2^D(2^s-1) (a085588_dvd, any_state_dvd). With s = A309786(n) this is a(n) | 2^A007814(n)(2^A309786(n)-1), the corrected direction of the 2024 comment. Numeric: two methods (fast operator powers + exact order; brute-force simulation) for n <= 200, 64 DATA terms, and the whole b-file n <= 1000.

A085588-literal.proof: The comment as written ('2^A007814(n)*(2^A309786(n)-1) divides a(n)') fails at n = 4 (a = 2) and n = 13 (a = 21 vs 63); 174 failures in the b-file, agree with the n the comment lists as a(n) != 2^D(2^s-1).

A085588-fixed-points.proof: Partial: a(n) = n implies m | 2^s - 1; the comment's first converse exception 445 is a typo for 455 (445 not in A115770; a(455) = 4095); every 2^i(2^j-1) with j >= 3 is in A115770 (carryless computation). n <= 1000: a(n) = n only for 2^i(2^j-1). The step 'a(n) = n => odd part is Mersenne' is not proved.

novelty.note: Same Frobenius argument as Martin-Odlyzko-Wolfram 1984 Theorem 3.5 for rule 90 (cited in the entry, original not read); Tadaki 1993 may already contain the rule 150 case. Nothing new is claimed; the value is correcting the reversed comment in OEIS and giving a checked proof.
